job.sentence: Nothing structural is new here: every frame and every side of every split in play has been seen before. The job is lexical — 4 new lego(s): "to guess" → "raten", "tomorrow" → "morgen", "happens" → "passiert", "what's going to happen tomorrow" → "was morgen passiert".

phrases.known_text: To guess
phrases.target_text: Raten
phrases.why: bare infinitive fragment, first exposure to raten, extends naturally into a want-chain

phrases.known_text: I want to guess
phrases.target_text: Ich will raten
phrases.why: want-chain frame, raten now in a full clause, medial position

phrases.known_text: I can guess when you are finished
phrases.target_text: Ich kann raten, wenn du fertig bist
phrases.why: modal-can frame, raten medial with a new right neighbour, adds temporal clause tail

phrases.known_text: I'd like to be able to guess
phrases.target_text: Ich möchte raten können
phrases.why: be-able-to frame, raten now left-adjacent to können, new right neighbour

phrases.known_text: I'm going to try to guess now
phrases.target_text: Ich werde jetzt versuchen zu raten
phrases.why: going-to future frame, raten pushed to final position after versuchen zu

phrases.known_text: I'm not sure whether I want to guess
phrases.target_text: Ich bin mir nicht sicher, ob ich raten will
phrases.why: know/sure matrix frame, raten embedded in an ob-clause, distinct left neighbour

phrases.known_text: To guess tomorrow
phrases.target_text: Raten morgen
phrases.why: time-adjunct fragment combining the prior lego, morgen final on both sides

phrases.known_text: To learn tomorrow with you
phrases.target_text: Lernen morgen mit dir
phrases.why: morgen now medial, followed by mit dir, fixing the all-final position spread

phrases.known_text: I'm going to practise tomorrow
phrases.target_text: Ich werde morgen üben
phrases.why: going-to future frame, morgen medial before the infinitive on the target side

phrases.known_text: I want to learn tomorrow
phrases.target_text: Ich will morgen lernen
phrases.why: want-chain frame, distinct left neighbour lernen

phrases.known_text: I can guess tomorrow
phrases.target_text: Ich kann morgen raten
phrases.why: modal-can frame, reuses raten as neighbour without repeating a whole basket

phrases.known_text: I'm not sure whether I want to guess tomorrow
phrases.target_text: Ich bin mir nicht sicher, ob ich morgen raten will
phrases.why: know/sure matrix frame, morgen embedded deep in the ob-clause, longest carrier

phrases.known_text: I don't want to guess what happens
phrases.target_text: Ich will nicht raten, was passiert
phrases.why: negation frame, passiert introduced right after the embedded was-clause opens

phrases.known_text: Happens tomorrow
phrases.target_text: Passiert morgen
phrases.why: bare fragment, passiert initial, pairs with the previous lego tomorrow

phrases.known_text: What happens
phrases.target_text: Was passiert
phrases.why: wh-question frame, passiert final in a two-word clause

phrases.known_text: I can explain what happens
phrases.target_text: Ich kann erklären, was passiert
phrases.why: embedded-question frame under a modal matrix, new left neighbour erklären

phrases.known_text: I'd like to explain what happens today
phrases.target_text: Ich möchte erklären, was heute passiert
phrases.why: embedded question with a time word inserted before passiert, new right neighbour

phrases.known_text: I want to explain what happens with you
phrases.target_text: Ich will erklären, was mit dir passiert
phrases.why: embedded question with mit dir inserted, another distinct right neighbour

phrases.known_text: I'd like to explain what doesn't happen
phrases.target_text: Ich möchte erklären, was nicht passiert
phrases.why: negation inside the embedded question, distinct left neighbour nicht

phrases.known_text: What's going to happen tomorrow
phrases.target_text: Was morgen passiert
phrases.why: the LEGO stands as the whole utterance, giving it initial position and fixing the all-final spread

phrases.known_text: I want to guess what's going to happen tomorrow
phrases.target_text: Ich will raten, was morgen passiert
phrases.why: want-chain frame, LEGO final, left neighbour guess

phrases.known_text: I don't want to guess what's going to happen tomorrow
phrases.target_text: Ich will nicht raten, was morgen passiert
phrases.why: negation frame, same left neighbour family but distinct matrix signature

phrases.known_text: I'd like to explain what's going to happen tomorrow
phrases.target_text: Ich möchte erklären, was morgen passiert
phrases.why: embedded-question frame with erklären, distinct left neighbour

phrases.known_text: I'm not sure what's going to happen tomorrow
phrases.target_text: Ich bin mir nicht sicher, was morgen passiert
phrases.why: know/sure matrix frame, distinct left neighbour sicher

phrases.known_text: I'd like to be able to guess what's going to happen tomorrow
phrases.target_text: Ich möchte raten können, was morgen passiert
phrases.why: be-able-to frame layered under want-chain, longest carrier for this LEGO
